title: Component docs written by a coding agent
description: What an agent writes through the frontdex MCP server (catalogue_enrich_write) after reading a component: what it is for and how to use it. Stored per component in .frontdex/enrichment/.

purpose.description: What the component is for, in one or two sentences.

summary.description: How it works: what it renders, what it reads and changes, when it shows what.

props.description: Per prop: what it does and how to pass it.

howToPass.description: Expected values, shape, who usually provides it, what happens if omitted.

functions.description: Per function or handler inside the component (or callback prop): what it does and when it runs.

usage.description: Usage examples: a title and a code snippet.

notes.description: Gotchas, constraints, accessibility or performance notes, things to keep in mind when changing it.
